title: Electrical Machines Laboratory 1
objectives:
The objective of this lab is to allow students to devise simple logic circuits, hence giving them an opportunity to
reinforce the theoretical concepts taught in the course “Electrical Machines 1”.
syllabus: The experiments cover relevant topics prescribed in the syllabus.
textbooks:
1. Electric machinery:Fitzgerald & Kingsley & Umans
2. Electric machines:Selemon & Straughen
3. Electric machinery fundamentals:S.T.Chapman
4. Analysis of Electric machinery:P.C.Krause
5. Direct Current Machines:M.G.Say
